content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling digital products with crypto payments is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure solution that allows creators to collect payments directly from their customers without relying on traditional payment processors. This means no more platform fees, no more delayed payments, and no more dependence on third-party services that can shut down or restrict access at any time. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can focus on what they do best – creating and selling digital products – while having complete control over their online store and payment processing.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A sovereign digital commerce stack is built with a combination of free and paid tools that provide a complete solution for digital creators. This includes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments is used for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a fee of just 0.5% per transaction. This architecture is designed to be scalable, secure, and customizable, giving creators the flexibility to adapt it to their specific needs.
Who This Is Built For and Why

A sovereign digital commerce stack is built for digital creators who want to sell digital products without relying on traditional payment processors. This includes ebook authors, course creators, template designers, font creators, preset makers, beat producers, plugin developers, and software creators who want to collect payments directly from their customers without platform fees. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, these creators can focus on growing their business and building their audience, rather than worrying about payment processing and platform restrictions.
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can keep up to 99.5% of your earnings and focus on growing your business.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A sovereign digital commerce stack is made up of several key components that work together to provide a complete solution for digital creators. These include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component is carefully selected to provide a scalable, secure, and customizable solution that meets the needs of digital creators.

This means creators can focus on what they do best – creating and selling digital products – while having complete control over their online store and payment processing. The answer is simple: NOWPayments charges just 0.5% per transaction, while traditional payment processors charge up to 10%. This means that at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921.
